summary.headline: Lord of the Fourth House
summary.text: Chapter XI interprets the lord of the fourth house in the twelve houses, describing effects on the father, brothers, children, marriage, inheritances, illness, and wandering. The preceding entries conclude predictions for the lord of the third house in houses eight through twelve.
